body:
https://carepyre.org/console.html and /console-api/* confirmed working for real through the public HTTPS URLs: register -> local-login -> identities/me all succeed, matching console.html's own expectations exactly. idunapro.service running under systemd --user, nginx /console-api/ proxy live. Three real fixes landed getting there (all ops-only, zero IDUNA_PRO source changes): sudo-queue/51 script fixed twice (root guard, then explicit D-Bus session env -- systemctl --user needs XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS explicitly set, not assumed from the ambient shell), and BASE_URL set so identities/me's authority_signature_cluster field is a real, externally-reachable URL instead of localhost:8081. MONOREPO commits 7f7e1ab/b98fec2, CarePyre commit be132ea.

⚓ ☃
title: CarePyre Console is live: real, verified end-to-end deploy on IDUNA_PRO
